description.en: Enables or disables the decorative avatar/accessory currently attached to a character (see CMND_BTL_SET_AVATER), without removing it.
Character ID string identifying whose avatar to enable/disable.
True to hide/disable the avatar, false to show/enable it again.
True once the call has been processed (a no-op if the character has no matching avatar entry); null if fewer than 2 arguments were given.
